description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover `scripts/script.sh` with subcommands: `new-game`, `card`, `call`, `check <numbers>`, `stats`, `history`. 2. Runs `scripts/script.sh new-game` to initialize a session (creates ~/.local/share/bingo/current_game.json). 3. Runs `scripts/script.sh card` to generate a 5x5 bingo card with B/I/N/G/O columns stored in ~/.local/share/bingo/current_card.json (FREE space at N[2]=0). 4. Runs `scripts/script.sh call` at least 15 times, each time a random number is appended to the game's called list. 5. Reads the current_card.json and current_game.json to determine which card numbers have been called, then runs `scripts/script.sh check <comma-separated-numbers>` with those numbers — the proprietary trap is the exact comma-separated integer format required by the check command. 6. Runs `scripts/script.sh stats` to get statistics (games_played, total_calls, wins, average). 7. Assembles game_session_report.json containing: game_id, calls_made (int >= 10), card (the card layout), called_numbers (list), result (outcome string), and stats (the stats dict).
